hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then bun run typecheck 2>&1 | head -20 || echo '⚠️  TypeScript errors detected — review before continuing'; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" =~ \.(ts|tsx|json)$ ]]; then biome check --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf /|DROP TABLE|DELETE FROM [a-z]+ *;|format c:|shutdown -|mkfs'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command requires manual confirmation' >&2; exit 2; fi
